'''Centax-1''',<ref name="TTSP" /> also spelled as '''Centax 1'''<ref name="JT" /><ref name="Insider">{{InsiderCite|84|Guide to the Grand Army of the Republic}}</ref><ref name="CNI:JT">''[[Coruscant Nights I: Jedi Twilight]]''</ref> and '''Centax One''',<ref name="JT" /> was one of the four [[Moon/Legends|moons]]<ref name="CatCW" /> of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="JT" />

==History==
{{Quote|Nejaa Halcyon, you will take a relief force of twenty thousand clones to Praesitlyn. Once there you will effect a landing of your army, assume overall command of the combined force, and destroy the Techno Union army there. You are authorized to dispose your ground and naval forces according to the battle plan you and your staff will devise en route to accomplish this mission in the most expeditious and effective way possible. You may select your own staff and designate whomever you wish to be your second in command. Time is short. When you leave here you will repair to Centax One, where your fleet is preparing for departure. You will effect that departure with all possible haste.|[[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]], to [[Nejaa Halcyon]]|<ref name="JT" />}}
[[File:Coruscant_system-TPM.jpg|thumb|left|285px|The planet Coruscant and three of its four moons]]
Following the [[Alsakan Conflicts/Legends|Alsakan Conflicts]], Centax-1 served as a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Prison/Legends|penal]] world.<ref name="TTSP" />

[[Centax-class heavy frigate|''Centax''-class heavy frigates]] were outfitted there during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and it was a military staging base that was [[Garrison/Legends|garrisoned]] with 20,000 [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]].<ref name="JT" />

In [[27 ABY/Legends|27 ABY]], during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Battle of Coruscant (Yuuzhan Vong War)|took]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] from the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] and began [[Terraforming/Legends|terraforming]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. During the process, Centax-1 was either [[Rings of Coruscant|destroyed]] or ejected from [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]].<ref name="Traitor">''[[The New Jedi Order: Traitor]]''</ref><ref name="Note">Although ''[[The New Jedi Order: Traitor]]'' does not specify which of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant's]] four [[Moon/Legends|moons]] was destroyed to create [[Rings of Coruscant|the Bridge]], the destroyed moon must have been either Centax-1 or [[Centax-3/Legends|Centax-3]], as the two remaining moons, [[Centax-2/Legends|Centax-2]] and [[Hesperidium/Legends|Hesperidium]], both appeared in stories dated after the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]. Centax-2 was featured in ''[[Legacy of the Force: Bloodlines]]'', and Hesperidium in ''[[Legacy of the Force: Sacrifice]]''.</ref>
